description.value:
As an action, you can call up a wave of restorative Force energy totaling hit points equal to five times your consular level, dividing that pool as you choose among any creatures within 30 feet. No single creature can be brought above half its hit point maximum this way, and the effect does nothing for droids or constructs.

You can use this feature three times, gaining an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level, with all uses restored on a long rest.
